# zenbot (vendored, non-NSFW)

Copied unchanged (apart from a credit line) from
[@soyaxell09/zenbot-scraper](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@soyaxell09/zenbot-scraper) v1.1.9
by AxelDev09 (https://github.com/AxelDev09), MIT licence (see LICENSE). Used by src/packs/x_zenbot.js:

| file | TAB BOT command |
|---|---|
| tiktok.js (tiktokDownload) | .tiktok |
| threads.js | .threads |
| youtube.js (ytSearch) | .yts |
| github.js (githubSearch) | .ghsearch |
| deezersearch.js (deezerFind) | .deezer |
| attp.js | .attp |

Only the scrapers that worked in a live test on 2026-10-23 were taken. Not taken (failed live or
already covered by a TAB BOT command): TikTok search/stalk, Instagram, Snaptik, Spotidown, Google Drive,
book search, QR read, URL expand, Aptoide (.apk exists), anime image search, lyrics, weather,
Pinterest, translate, news, upload, screenshot, shortener (TAB BOT already has these).
